clusters.headline: Samajwadi Party Names Five Candidates Amid Congress Seat Disputes
aiSummaryBullets: The Samajwadi Party released a list of five candidates for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.
Two of the constituencies announced by the Samajwadi Party were reportedly on the Congress party's list of requested seats.

clusters.headline: Tensions Rise Over Karthigai Deepam Lighting In Tirupparankundram
aiSummaryBullets: Protests and clashes occurred between Hindu devotees and police in Tirupparankundram regarding the Karthigai Deepam lamp lighting.
The Tamil Nadu government faces allegations of defying a Supreme Court order concerning the lighting ceremony at the Deepathoon site.

clusters.headline: Assam Man Rahul Roy Arrested For Alleged Rape Of Nine-Year-Old
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Roy was taken into custody following allegations of sexually assaulting a nine-year-old girl in Assam.
The mother of the child claimed the abuse occurred multiple times, coming to light after the girl fell ill.

Times of India reports: Delhi cafe horror: Woman gangraped by colleagues after late-night party, 3 held

clusters.headline: Bisleri States Disputed Water Batch Removed After FSSAI Scrutiny
aiSummaryBullets: Bisleri stated that the affected water batch from its Goa facility has been removed from the market.
The company maintains that subsequent production samples have met food safety standards following retesting.

clusters.headline: At Least 24 People Killed In Bus-Truck Collision In Assam State
aiSummaryBullets: A collision involving a bus and a truck occurred in Assam, India.
The incident resulted in at least 24 confirmed fatalities.

clusters.headline: Kerala High Court Overturns Suspensions At Sanskrit University
aiSummaryBullets: The Kerala High Court invalidated the suspension orders and inquiry reports issued against students at the Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit.
Student protesters argued that they were suspended without receiving reasons or a fair opportunity to defend themselves during the inquiry process.

clusters.headline: BJP Criticizes Rahul Gandhi Over Security And Religious Remarks
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP has publicly condemned Rahul Gandhi for his recent statements regarding religious figures and national security.
Rahul Gandhi alleged that his father's security was deliberately removed, while the BJP characterized him as harboring hatred for the country.

clusters.headline: New Reports Detail Chinese Satellite Activity During Operation Sindoor
aiSummaryBullets: Chinese satellites reportedly surveilled India's western coast and military sites during Operation Sindoor in 2022.
A US panel suggests China provided support to Pakistan during the operation to counteract India's regional influence.

clusters.headline: West Bengal Cabinet Approves State Renaming To Paschim Banga
aiSummaryBullets: The West Bengal cabinet officially approved the proposal to rename the state to Paschim Banga in both Hindi and English.
Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari is scheduled to introduce the formal motion for this renaming process in the legislative assembly on December 9.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Permits Limited Lamp Lighting At Tirupparankundram
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court sanctioned a limited, one-time lighting of a lamp atop the Tirupparankundram hill.
The Madras High Court subsequently ordered local authorities to comply with the Supreme Court's directive regarding the event.

clusters.headline: Karthigai Deepam Lit At Traditional Site Despite Court Orders
aiSummaryBullets: The traditional Karthigai Deepam was lit at the customary hilltop site in Thirupparankundram despite prior court directives.
Madurai district authorities informed the Madras High Court that actions are being taken to align administrative steps with Supreme Court rulings.

clusters.headline: UP Gas Price Hike Increases CNG And PNG Costs Across Five Cities
aiSummaryBullets: CNG prices rose by Rs 2 per kilogram in five cities across Uttar Pradesh.
PNG rates also increased by Rs 1 per standard cubic meter in the affected regions.

Times of India reports: US, China, India top Asia power rankings; PM Modi ranks 2nd to Xi as leader

clusters.headline: Amit Shah Discusses Reopening Kartarpur Corridor And Security
aiSummaryBullets: Amit Shah announced that the Kartarpur Corridor is set to reopen once national security issues are resolved.
He attributed the current location of the site outside of India to the past actions of the Congress party.

clusters.headline: Savarkar Family Issues Legal Notice Over Sonia Gandhi Memoir Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Savarkar family has initiated legal action against Sonia Gandhi regarding content in her recently published memoir.
The family alleges that the book presents a distorted account of Vinayak Damodar Savarkar.
